prompt_en: Create a photorealistic fantasy conservation-documentation photograph in a shallowly flooded museum gallery. Image 1 is visible-appearance guidance only for an original adult fictional woman, whose visible facial appearance and long dark wavy hair are guided by Image 1. Preserve the reference-visible facial structure, hairline, dark wavy hair texture, and natural makeup balance. She kneels with one hand stabilizing a complete closed magic circle inlaid directly into wet marble. Center a surface-anchored magic circle enforcing a local rule: one complete closed boundary remains visible without cropped gaps; the boundary conforms to a real floor wall table or object surface, here following the wet marble in coherent perspective; light material motion or state differs visibly inside versus outside, with still softly luminous water within and ordinary ripples beyond; the fictional effect terminates bends or changes exactly at the boundary line; dust liquid shadow scorch or object contact records the local rule through damp dust and a narrow scorch trace. Beside her, one complete articulated suit of living armor independently lifts a fallen gilded frame from the water. Keep the visibly hollow articulated living armor entirely legible: helmet torso arm and leg armor form one complete shell; overlapping plates and joint gaps bend coherently at shoulders elbows hips and knees; an open visor neck gap or gauntlet opening reveals empty interior volume; balanced posture contact shadows and plate movement show unsupported agency; a grasped object opened door or displaced dust responds to the armor, here as the frame rises and grounded metal feet send concentric ripples. Use a medium-wide diagonal composition showing the whole circle, both water regions, her stabilizing hand, the complete armor, its empty openings, and the lifted frame. Cool skylight and restrained amber circle glow separate wet stone, metal, skin, and water while retaining natural photographic texture.
